content:
The Paranormal Pals, a group of five friends from northwest Wisconsin, will present Investigating the Paranormal on Oct. 29 as part of the Thursdays at the U series at the UW-Eau Claire – Barron County.

The program will run from 12:30-1:30 p.m. in the Blue Hills Lecture Hall in Ritzinger Hall and will be livestreamed at ricelaketv.com.

The Paranormal Pals

The Paranormal Pals utilize the newest tools and technology to uncover the truth in the paranormal. Their investigations have taken them to local establishments in Rice Lake and throughout Wisconsin, Iowa and Minnesota.

The group also shares their paranormal experiences, investigations and evidence on social media and on the “Paranormal Pals” podcast.

The Thursdays at the U weekly series is free and open to the public thanks to support from the UW-Eau Claire – Barron County Foundation. Neither seating reservations nor parking permits are needed for in-person attendees.

While in-person attendance is encouraged, most presentations in the series are livestreamed and archived on the Thursdays at the U webpage.

The next program in the series will be Nov. 5, with Esther Stewart presenting The Story of Ancient Lava Flows Beneath Lake Superior.

For more information about the series, contact Laura Holden at 715-788-6207 or holdenlk@uwec.edu.
